chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said to Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Shāmī:
"Do not associate with the Kurds, for the Kurds are a group from the jinn whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has uncovered the veil from."

key_terms.تُخَالِطِ: to mix or associate closely with

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh say about associating with the Kurds?
ai.summary: This report relates a statement of the Imam عليه السلام to Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Shāmī warning against associating with the Kurds. It presents a theological claim about their origin, describing them as a group from the jinn from whom Allah عزّ وجلّ removed the covering.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3603 - Imam (as) said to Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami:
"Do not associate with the Kurds, for the Kurds are a group from the Jinn whom Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, has removed the veil from."
